summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release that discloses routine share purchases by executives under the company's HMRC-approved Share Incentive Plan (Partnership Share Scheme) on July 1, 2026. The CEO bought 3 shares at £45.63, the CMO bought 4 shares, and a director bought 3 shares. No special-situation elements such as an acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or tender are present. This is a standard equity compensation notification with no structural change to the company.
